***[[28 August 2025 Israeli attacks on Yemen]]
****The [[Houthis]] confirm the death of [[Prime Minister of Yemen|Prime Minister]] [[Ahmed al-Rahawi]] and an unspecified number of ministers from an [[Israel]]i airstrike two days earlier. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-houthis-israeli-strike-494d91b05e04a5dbaeda0205ef349a39 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Archaeology|Archaeologists]] discover 40 ancient tombs dating back to at least 2,300 years ago at the [[Mosul Dam]] reservoir in [[Dohuk Governorate]] in the [[Kurdistan Region]] of [[Iraq]], following lowered water levels from a [[drought]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2613574/middle-east (''Arab News'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/31/drought-in-iraq-unearths-more-than-2000-years-old-tombs (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fourteen people are killed and three others are critically injured in a [[head-on collision]] between a police van and a prison bus outside of [[Mariental, Namibia|Mariental]], [[Namibia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3v3g9z139wo (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed and 103 others are injured when a train derails between [[Alexandria]] and [[Matrouh Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Indonesian protests]]
**[[August 2025 Indonesian protests]]
***Unrest in [[Indonesia]], following a [[Government of Indonesia|government]] truck [[Affan Kurniawan|killing a 21-year-old]], continues as a mob loots the houses of [[People's Representative Council|parliament members]] [[Ahmad Sahroni]], [[Eko Patrio]] and [[:id:Uya Kuya|Uya Kuya]]. [https://www.jawapos.com/nasional/016506774/usai-rumah-ahmad-sahroni-dan-eko-patrio-beredar-video-diduga-rumah-uya-kuya-digeruduk-dan-dijarah-massa (Jawa Pos)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/police-killing-sparks-indonesia-unrest-first-major-test-prabowo-presidency-2025-08-29/ (Reuters)]
***Four people are killed amid spreading protests in Indonesia, including three government workers who jumped from a building on fire and one who was attacked by a crowd. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/30/world/asia/indonesia-protests-dead-prabowo-subianto.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Assassination of Andriy Parubiy]]
**Former speaker of the [[Verkhovna Rada|Ukrainian parliament]] [[Andriy Parubiy]] is assassinated by an unknown gunman in [[Lviv]], [[Lviv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. A manhunt is underway for the suspect. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjw6ep37469o (BBC News)]
*A man [[Vehicle-ramming attack|drives a car into a crowd]] outside a bar in [[Évreux]], [[France]], after a dispute, killing one person and injuring five others, including two critically. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/30/car-rams-crowd-outside-bar-evreux-northern-france-death-normandy (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Nicaragua]]n [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] groups report that attorney Carlos Cárdenas, arrested on August 15 during [[National Police of Nicaragua|police]] operations against [[Government of Nicaragua|government]] critics, has died in state custody, marking the fifth such death of a detainee since 2019. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/second-opposition-leader-nicaragua-reported-dead-state-custody-this-week-2025-08-30/ (Reuters)]
